title: From monologue to dialogue — identity film

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Connect a small set of recognizable ingredients to varied encounters, because people meet the same brand through different screens and situations.
strategic_value: Simplified rings, adaptable Audi Type and a shared palette can keep Audi recognizable while its communications change format.
demonstration: The 89.48-second film moves from people and driving scenes through rings, type, palette, imagery, interface icons and controls, the brand portal and applications.
practical_value: Compare the continuity of ingredients across explanation, interface and campaign rather than treating each format as a separate identity.

content_islands.name: Human context
content_islands.spec: Open with automotive and everyday-life footage and principle words.

content_islands.name: Identity ingredients
content_islands.spec: Sequence the rings, variable typography, neutral/red palette and images through full-frame demonstrations.

content_islands.name: Digital tools and applications
content_islands.spec: Show icons, controls, portal and ring calculator before web applications and a scenic logo ending.

reference_purposes.Intent: The film identifies Audi Type as a brand identifier and basis for flexibility; accompanying KMS prose explains the need for adaptable digital communication.
reference_purposes.Expression: The film changes scale, placement, imagery and typography while retaining Audi rings and shared colors.
reference_purposes.Application: Screens demonstrate the identity in controls, websites, mobile layouts and a brand portal.
